mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_order (id, enterprise_id, source_system, source_order_no, request_digest, status, strategy_version, owner_id, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceOrderNo}, #{digest}, #{status}, #{strategyVersion}, #{ownerId}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, source_system, source_order_no, request_digest, status, strategy_version, active_attempt_id, version FROM fulfillment_order WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_line (id, enterprise_id, fulfillment_id, source_line_id, sku_id, requested_qty, base_unit, min_remaining_days, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{fulfillmentId}, #{sourceLineId}, #{skuId}, #{qty}, #{unit}, #{minDays}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO fulfillment_attempt_command(enterprise_id,command_id,fulfillment_id,payload_hash,claim_id,created_at) VALUES(#{enterpriseId},#{commandId},#{fulfillmentId},#{hash},#{claimId},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE command_id=command_id
mapper.select: SELECT fulfillment_id,payload_hash,claim_id,attempt_id FROM fulfillment_attempt_command WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND command_id=#{commandId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_attempt_command SET attempt_id=#{attemptId} WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND command_id=#{commandId} AND claim_id=#{claimId} AND attempt_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allocation_attempt (id, enterprise_id, fulfillment_id, state, deadline, participant_set_hash, allocation_digest, cancel_requested, launch_epoch, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{fulfillmentId}, #{state}, #{deadline}, #{hash}, #{digest}, 0, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, fulfillment_id, state, deadline, xid, tc_observed_status, tc_terminal_evidence, participant_set_hash, allocation_digest, cancel_requested, launch_epoch, launch_owner, launch_lease_until, xid_bound_at, version FROM allocation_attempt WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allocation_participant (id, enterprise_id, attempt_id, warehouse_id, state, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{attemptId}, #{warehouseId}, #{state}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO participant_line (id, enterprise_id, participant_id, order_line_id, sku_id, qty, base_unit, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{participantId}, #{orderLineId}, #{skuId}, #{qty}, #{unit}, 0, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO allocation_launch (id, enterprise_id, attempt_id, launch_epoch, executor_id, state, cleanup_state, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{enterpriseId}, #{attemptId}, #{epoch}, #{executorId}, #{state}, #{cleanup}, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, xid, state, tc_observed_status, tc_terminal_evidence FROM allocation_attempt WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND xid IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('TCC_TRYING','TCC_COMPLETING') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT id FROM allocation_attempt WHERE enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND tc_observed_status='Committed' AND tc_terminal_evidence IS NOT NULL AND tc_terminal_evidence<>'' AND ((state IN ('TCC_TRYING','TCC_COMPLETING') AND compensation_cancellation_id IS NULL) OR (state='ALLOCATED' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillment_outbox o WHERE o.enterprise_id=allocation_attempt.enterprise_id AND o.attempt_id=allocation_attempt.id AND o.event_type IN ('AllocationCompleted','OutboundOrderRequested','ExecutionAuthorizationRequested')) < 1+2*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allocation_participant p WHERE p.enterprise_id=allocation_attempt.enterprise_id AND p.attempt_id=allocation_attempt.id))) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_outbox (event_id, enterprise_id, attempt_id, warehouse_id, event_type, operation_id, payload, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{attemptId}, #{warehouseId}, #{eventType}, #{operationId}, CAST(#{payload} AS JSON), 'PENDING', 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_outbox SET delivery_payload=CAST(#{payload} AS JSON) WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND delivery_payload IS NULL AND status='PENDING'
